description: Land Acquisition - Aluthwewa, Galewela D/S Division, Mathale District - Udagama, Warakalavita, Hanguranketha D/S Division, Nuwaraeliya District - Warakalavita, Hanguranketha D/S Division, Nuwara Eliya District
categorisation: This gazette content primarily deals with land acquisition matters under the Land Acquisition Act. It contains detailed descriptions of specific land parcels, their boundaries, extents, and locations, along with orders for taking possession of these lands. While it mentions a government minister (S.M. Chandrasena), the core content is about land acquisition rather than government personnel changes or portfolio assignments, making it a Land Gazette (Type 4).
